old_problem: The historical review treated the OOB setter, byte encoding and time-basis behavior as unresolved core semantics. IPMI 2.0 section 31.11b and Appendix G define Set SEL Time UTC Offset as optional Storage NetFn 0Ah/Cmd 5Dh with exactly two little-endian bytes containing signed minutes from -1440 through +1440 or 07FFh unspecified. Section 31.11a defines mandatory 5Ch readback when 5Dh exists. The secure endpoint, safe target, chronology window and exact baseline restore are Project-controlled execution inputs, not reasons to leave the standard operation Pending.
disposition_reason: Bind a secure OOB session to the intended BMC, preserve raw SEL/time evidence, capture the complete 5Ch baseline, encode one distinct owner-approved target into exactly two little-endian bytes, display target and restore bytes for immediate confirmation, write 5Dh once, require exact 5Ch readback, prove SEL-clock continuity and raw-record integrity, then restore the exact baseline once and verify it. Contain DST/time-sync writers and downstream chronology consumers because the offset changes UTC interpretation. Set SEL Time 49h is prohibited because it resets the offset to 07FFh. Unsupported is N/A only with authoritative platform evidence, never from an OOB transport/session error; no guessed value, invented skew, log clear, retry or IB substitution is allowed.
decision_basis: Master XLSX rows 1203-1207, exact same-row DeepSeek, exact GPT second review, tests.json, selection manifest and historical V3.1 record were directly read. The related OOB getter row 1205/new review 233 and IB setter row 1079/new review 224 were read while retaining separate identities. Formal queue sequence 84 was independently verified as row 1207 / variant e54528cae69e5b9f.

IPMI v2.0 Appendix G assigns Set SEL Time UTC Offset to Storage NetFn 0Ah/Cmd 5Dh. Section 31.11b requires exactly two request bytes, least-significant byte first, representing a 16-bit two's-complement number of minutes from UTC to SEL Time.

Defined ordinary values are -1440 through +1440 minutes. 07FFh is the distinct unspecified sentinel, meaning SEL time is interpreted as local time; it must be handled before ordinary signed-range validation.

The normative relationship is SEL/local time = UTC + offset and UTC = SEL/local time - offset. Daylight-saving transitions may require an authorized writer to update the field, so the target value and expected chronology must be bound to a captured instant and owner policy.

Get 0Ah/5Ch returns the stored two-byte value and is mandatory when Set 5Dh exists. A successful 5Dh completion is not evidence of correct state; exact 5Ch readback is required after target and restore writes.

Set SEL Time 0Ah/49h resets the UTC-offset field to 07FFh. It cannot be used as a recovery shortcut, and firmware/time-sync software capable of 49h or 5Dh writes must be contained so attribution and restore remain valid.

The offset changes interpretation metadata rather than rewriting old SEL records or setting the SEL clock. Even so, monitoring, incident and warranty consumers may present shifted UTC chronology. Immutable raw SEL capture plus a controlled consumer window protects evidence.

A setter test needs a target semantically different from BASE; rewriting BASE proves no state transition. TARGET may be another valid signed-minute value or 07FFh only when the time owner explicitly approves its temporary interpretation and exact restore.

OOB-specific safety includes endpoint/asset binding, protected credentials, session/privilege evidence and distinction between protocol unsupported and transport/authentication failure. IB row 1079 cannot cross-credit the remote path.

ED-03 permits standard BMC commands without guessed OEM alternatives; ED-12 separates mutation directions; ED-15 forbids invented thresholds; ED-17 preserves SEL evidence; ED-19 separates IB/OOB; ED-28/ED-30 require approval/recovery; ED-34 parameterizes Project values; ED-38 prohibits automatic retry.

test_case.test_name: IPMI Set SEL Time UTC Offset (OOB Storage 0Ah/5Dh) controlled chronology change, 5Ch readback and exact restore
test_case.purpose: Set one distinct approved SEL UTC-offset value over the authenticated OOB path, validate exact standard encoding, readback and bounded chronology interpretation, then restore the original field without rewriting SEL records, changing the SEL clock, clearing evidence or substituting the IB variant.
required_package: Approved BMC/SUT/firmware and host-verified secret-safe LANPlus endpoint with authoritative 5Dh support; pinned raw OOB writer/reader preserving endpoint identity, exact request, completion, stderr and response bytes
Complete 5Ch BASE classified as signed minutes or 07FFh, one distinct TARGET_OFFSET_MINUTES or approved TARGET_UNSPECIFIED_07FFH, and precomputed BASE/TARGET little-endian bytes
BMC/time and incident owners, maintenance window, compliance clearance, downstream SEL consumer inventory and immediate human confirmation after exact target and restore bytes are displayed
Immutable raw SEL export/hash, SEL Info and 48h SEL Time baseline, trusted UTC, named timezone/DST state and Project-approved ALLOWED_CLOCK_SKEW_SECONDS

Containment proving no concurrent 49h, 5Dh, DST updater or other time-policy writer can race the transaction; independent local-interface observation may aid recovery but cannot replace this OOB evidence
test_case.test_command: AUTHORIZED OOB CHRONOLOGY-AFFECTING PROCEDURE; DO NOT EXECUTE DURING REVIEW. Record Source Key/variant; bind DNS/IP, FRU/serial and firmware to the intended SUT; use protected credentials and export/hash raw SEL plus SEL Info, 0Ah/48h SEL Time, trusted UTC and 0Ah/5Ch BASE without clearing logs. Decode BASE with sentinel-first rules. Require no incident hold, no active 49h/5Dh/DST writer, isolated consumers, approved skew and a distinct approved TARGET. Encode a signed target as U=TARGET_OFFSET_MINUTES&0xFFFF, LO=U&0xFF, HI=(U>>8)&0xFF; encode unspecified only as FF 07. Offline-unit-check examples: +480=E0 01, -480=20 FE, +1440=A0 05, -1440=60 FA. Display endpoint, BASE, TARGET, interpretation and exact restore bytes for immediate confirmation. Send once over host-verified secret-safe LANPlus: `ipmitool -I lanplus -H <BMC> -U <USER> -E raw 0x0a 0x5d 0xLO 0xHI`. Require completion 00h, then one 0Ah/5Ch read and exact TARGET bytes. Re-read 48h and raw SEL evidence; require clock continuity within approved skew, no existing record rewrite and correct SEL=UTC+target interpretation when specified. Send exact BASE bytes once, require completion 00h and 5Ch exact BASE readback, then verify time, SEL and consumer recovery. Never call 49h, clear logs, alter client-host time, retry, or use row-1079 IB output as OOB coverage.
test_case.expected_result: The exact two-byte target 5Dh request reaches the verified BMC once and completes 00h; immediate 5Ch returns identical bytes and decodes to the approved target. SEL clock continuity remains within the approved skew, raw existing SEL records remain byte-identical except separately accounted concurrent additions, and contained consumers reflect the documented UTC/local relationship. The exact baseline restore completes once, 5Ch equals BASE, chronology returns to the approved interpretation and no logs are cleared. Unsupported 5Dh is N/A only with authoritative platform evidence, not an OOB session error. Any mismatch, race, evidence rewrite, unapproved impact or incomplete restore is FAIL.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires the exact OOB Source Key/variant, endpoint-to-asset binding, authoritative 5Dh support, immutable baseline, a distinct approved target, correct two-byte signed/sentinel encoding, immediate confirmation, one target write plus exact 5Ch readback, no raw-record or SEL-clock corruption, approved chronology comparison, one exact BASE restore and final 5Ch/time/SEL/consumer proof. FAIL covers wrong target/endpoint, sign/endian/range error, completion without readback, unexpected 49h/5Dh writer, record rewrite, consumer impact outside containment, target/baseline mismatch, retry or restore failure. NOT READY covers absent support, credential-safe runner, BASE, TARGET, threshold, ownership, containment, confirmation or recovery. N/A needs authoritative lack of 5Dh support; transport/authentication/privilege/timeout failure is not N/A evidence.
safety_gate: This global interpretation change requires a dedicated maintenance window, incident/compliance clearance, time/BMC-owner control and immediate confirmation after endpoint, target bytes and restore bytes are shown.
Bind the remote endpoint to FRU/serial and firmware; never put a password in process arguments or retained logs. Wrong-target uncertainty is an immediate stop.
Preserve/hash raw SEL records before writing. Never execute the source's log clear, delete records or suppress consumers to manufacture a clean comparison.
Stop or coordinate every automatic 49h/5Dh/DST writer. A 49h call resets the field to 07FFh and invalidates target/readback/recovery attribution.
Use one distinct Project-approved value only. Do not sweep boundaries on the DUT, guess timezone, infer from the client host or accept an unapproved clock-skew margin.
Use OOB only for this identity. Local-interface observation may support recovery but cannot satisfy row 1206 or convert the independent IB row 1079 into OOB coverage.

No automatic retry. On target failure or ambiguity, read 5Ch once; restore BASE once only under the preapproved recovery if state changed and the owner confirms it is safe. Failed restore freezes further time/log actions and escalates.
expected_evidence: Exact Source Key/variant; BMC/SUT/firmware/FRU and OOB endpoint/channel binding; official 31.11a-31.11b and Appendix G authority; 5Dh capability and distinct IB identity
Immutable pre-write raw SEL export/hash, SEL Info, 48h SEL Time, trusted UTC, 5Ch BASE raw/decoded value, secure-session evidence and competing-writer containment
Approved distinct target, timezone/DST interpretation, skew, maintenance/incident clearance, immediate confirmation and precomputed target/restore bytes
Versioned writer hash, exact redacted 5Dh target request/completion, immediate 5Ch raw equality and signed/sentinel decode
Target-state clock continuity, chronology calculation, raw-record integrity and downstream consumer audit
Exact 5Dh BASE restore/completion, final 5Ch BASE equality, final time/SEL/consumer integrity and PASS/FAIL/NOT READY/N/A; explicit statement that the review agent performed no DUT action
test_case.recovery: Retain BASE bytes and the exact OOB 5Dh restore request before authorization. If target write fails, read 5Ch once and stop; when BASE is unchanged, do not write again. If state changed or is ambiguous, the owner may send the preapproved BASE once over the verified endpoint, then require 5Ch equality, SEL-time continuity, raw-record integrity and consumer recovery. Never use 49h, client-host clock changes, SEL clear, BMC reset or the IB setter as improvised recovery. If baseline cannot be proven, preserve evidence, quarantine chronology produced during the window and escalate without retry.

source_conflict.reason: IPMI 2.0 resolves the OOB setter, payload, readback, range, sentinel, time relationship and 49h interaction. The Review layer replaces unsafe TBD/log-clear boilerplate with an endpoint-bound, evidence-preserving, confirmed target/readback/restore transaction.

blocked.reason: The standard defines the mutation and its readback/recovery primitive. Target value, secure endpoint, time-owner containment, approved skew, consumer window and authorization are bounded Project prerequisites rather than missing command semantics.

external_authorities.title: Intelligent Platform Management Interface Specification v2.0 rev. 1.1 E7
external_authorities.application: Sections 31.11a-31.11b, Table 31-1 and Appendix G define Storage 0Ah/Cmd5Dh, exact two-byte little-endian signed-minute/sentinel payload, 5Ch readback relationship, UTC-to-SEL sign, DST responsibility, optional support and the rule that Set SEL Time 49h resets the offset to unspecified.

project_authority: The BMC/time and incident owners bind endpoint/firmware, supported command, baseline, distinct target, timezone/DST/skew oracle, competing writers, maintenance window, consumers, restore and DUT verdict. They cannot redefine encoding, waive immutable SEL evidence, turn OOB failure into N/A, accept completion without 5Ch, merge IB/OOB coverage, permit retry or use 49h/log clearing as recovery.
